'''Khreusis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he had stolen the ancient Sith Lord [[Aloysius Kallig]]'s [[Kallig's Countenance|mask]] and was living on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in his own [[Lord Khreusis's stronghold|stronghold]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
Trained as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Khreusis eventually reached the rank of Sith Lord. He had in his possession the mask of an ancient Sith Lord, Aloysius Kallig, and wore it with pride. He lived on Korriban in his fortress, high up in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]], where he was challenged by a young [[Darth Nox|Sith apprentice]]. Originally, Khreusis thought the apprentice was there as assigned by their [[Darth Zash|master]], but instead, the apprentice was there to retrieve the mask of their ancestor as the latter had commanded the young Sith to. The apprentice soon thereafter revealed this fact and Khreusis threatened that he would tell [[Darth Thanaton]] about the situation. Khreusis engaged the apprentice in a duel and was easily beaten, the mask he wore finally returned to Kallig's bloodline.

==Powers and abilities==
Khreusis was trained as a [[Sith Warrior]] and, as such, he relied more on [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] combat although he still possessed some [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] like [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. But even with his skills developed, he wasn't a match for Kallig's heir.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Khreusis_Unmasked.png|thumb|right|180px|Khreusis unmasked]]
Khreusis was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].

===Gameplay alternatives===
He appears in Lord Khreusis's Stronghold, a fortress on Korriban. Besides killing him, there is another option to gain Khreusis as an ally, which requires the use of neutral dialogue options, leading to Khreusis testing the player by ordering his two apprentices to attack. After the player wins, he gives the mask willingly, thus showing his face.<ref name="TOR" />
